title: April Expense Account Coding
brief: Prepare an account-mapping table for the April operating expenses and flag items that need clarification before posting.

delegate.scenario: You are the staff accountant at invented company Cedarline Fabrication, preparing April 2026 transactions for the general ledger. The controller will review your account assignments and any unresolved questions before the month-end close on 05/08/2026.
delegate.inputs:
April 2026 coding notes — Cedarline Fabrication
Use the chart below for these operating expenses. All amounts are USD.

| Account | Name |
| --- | --- |
| 6100 | Office supplies |
| 6210 | Utilities |
| 6350 | Repairs and maintenance |
| 6420 | Professional services |

Transactions from the AP queue:
- 04/03/2026, Northstar Paper, invoice NP-441, printer paper and toner, $486.20; proposed account 6100.
- 04/07/2026, Harbor Electric, invoice HE-208, shop electricity, $1,240.00; proposed account 6210.
- 04/11/2026, WeldPro Service, invoice WP-77, welding unit repair, $680.00; proposed account 6350.
- 04/15/2026, LedgerPoint LLC, invoice LP-19, quarterly bookkeeping support, $315.00; proposed account 6420.

AP queue summary for the three shop invoices: $2,325.00.

Email from AP clerk, 04/16/2026: "Northstar Paper invoice NP-441 is $468.20. Please keep the proposed account code."
delegate.goal: A good result lets the controller review sensible account assignments and resolve source-data questions before posting.

criteria.text: Says the table is for the controller reviewing April operating expenses before month-end close.
Uses only the provided chart of accounts and preserves the transaction dates, vendors, and invoice references.
Separates proposed account assignments from items that need clarification and does not silently choose between conflicting source details.
Asks the AI to tie amounts and totals back to the source records and flag any mismatch.
Requests a concise table followed by a short list of questions, with amounts shown in USD.

traps.description: The AP queue summary for the three shop invoices does not equal the sum of those invoice amounts.
evidence: AP queue summary for the three shop invoices: $2,325.00

traps.description: The email gives a different amount for Northstar Paper invoice NP-441 than the transaction entry does.
evidence: invoice NP-441, printer paper and toner, $486.20

delegate.exemplar: Prepare a concise account-mapping table for the controller reviewing Cedarline Fabrication’s April 2026 operating expenses before the 05/08/2026 month-end close. Use only the supplied chart of accounts, and retain each transaction’s date, vendor, and invoice reference. Show the proposed account and amount in USD; do not resolve conflicting source details by guessing. Tie amounts and any stated totals back to the source records, and list mismatches or questions separately before posting. Keep the table followed by a short clarification list.
